content: Google Play's Data Safety form is mandatory for every app, even ones collecting nothing -- there is no skip option. 'Collected' is defined as data transmitted off-device; data processed and stored entirely on-device (e.g. localStorage/Preferences save data) does not count as 'collected or shared.' A fully offline app with local-only save data can truthfully declare 'no data collected or shared,' but must still fill out and submit the form, and Apple's equivalent (App Privacy 'Privacy Nutrition Label' in App Store Connect) has the same on-device-only exception and still must be completed.
